address: 396/1 Maha Rat Road, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: A spectacular setting, where views of the Chao Phraya River and Wat Arun provide the perfect backdrop to your culinary journey inside one of Bangkok’s most precious historic houses. Well-known for its delicate and authentic royal Thai cuisine, the menu offers a different set selection every day. Impressive dishes include river prawns in spicy and sour coconut broth with banana blossom and Chakrabongse roasted duck red curry with mixed fruits....
